Thanks for the ping — happy to own intake for OrbitSuite. Below is the intake checklist and proposed next steps (I copied links to internal docs):

Vendor intake checklist (for marketplace listings):
- Validate vendor legal entity and match to W-9 / tax docs. If non-US, request W-8BEN-E and local tax docs.
- Confirm primary billing entity: "Redwood Inference, Inc." (HQ address below) OR specific marketplace subsidiary if marketplace billing differs.
- Insurance: check vendor provides general liability; for marketplace partners we ask for a minimum of $1M GL.
- Confirm SOW scope and whether revenue share or usage billing applies.
- Create HubSpot vendor record and attach OrbitSuite_VendorForm_20260606.pdf and SOW.
- Send DocuSign: RBW Marketplace Partner Agreement (pre-populated) + SOW for signature.
- PO routing: procurements should send PO to vendor-ops@redwood.com with HubSpot deal id in the subject (RBW-DEAL-2026-0891). Finance will match PO to HubSpot/staging invoice.

Proposed timeline:
- Tue 2026-06-09: I will validate vendor docs and upload into HubSpot; assign vendor id.
- Wed 2026-06-10: Send DocuSign package to OrbitSuite (Partner Agreement + SOW).
- Thu 2026-06-11: Finance confirms PO acceptance procedure and provides PO template/required fields.

Doc links: https://docs.redwood.com/vendor-intake-template (internal); HubSpot owner: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/67890

Attachments I will add: RBW_marketplace_po_instructions.pdf (internal procurement PO template).

Let me know if you want me to include any special clause for cloud marketplaces (we typically add the marketplace listing clause + data residency note if EU).

Laura Bennett
